hypothesis: The inactive v28 portfolio can preserve broad bidirectional live research while making its route evidence quality explicit and removing only the independently rejected SOL HT-Breakout transfer.
decision: Reject inactive v28 as the next executable portfolio revision now that every declared provider-symbol route has evidence classification. Only six of its 23 executable routes are historically supportive candidates; four are contradictory and thirteen are negative. The sole observe-only SOL HT-Breakout mapping also remains independently rejected. Preserve v28, its rollback bundle, and every trial result, but build the next inactive portfolio revision from explicitly selected bidirectional replacements rather than promoting this evidence-negative route mixture. This is a versioned research decision, not a hidden runtime gate, and it does not mutate the running portfolio.
falsifier: Fresh independently resolved, after-cost, venue-matched evidence can update any individual route through a new journal revision. A profile or evidence hash mismatch, a route count other than 24 observed and 23 executable, or an omitted route classification invalidates this record. No result automatically filters or promotes a running trial.
limitations: Supportive means historically promising enough for a controlled candidate, not proven live profitability.
Contradictory mappings contain positive and negative slices or directions that do not support a stable bidirectional expectation.
Negative and contradictory labels are journaled research decisions; the ungated-execution charter forbids turning them into undeclared runtime aborts.
The underlying evidence mixes bar-replay diagnostics and small live samples, so route labels have different empirical strength even though every mapping is classified.
The v28 profile remains inactive and this revision does not place, close, resize, filter, restart, or promote any live route.
